description: Part-load efficiency with flue/auxiliary losses, ambient temperature correction, CO2 intensity. Adds gasifier turndown penalties, HRSG flue loss, and auxiliary power fraction to F1a.

unit.name: Generic 400 MW Coal IGCC (GE/Texaco-type entrained-flow gasifier)
unit.source: Cormos, C.-C. (2012). Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 37(4), 3083-3095; IEA GHG R&D Programme (2003); Booras & Holt (2004) EPRI; Higman & van der Burgt (2008) Gasification, 2nd ed. Elsevier.

eta_iso.note: Net LHV efficiency at rated load (PLR=1, T_amb=15C, no flue loss penalty)

k_amb.note: Ambient derating coefficient (~0.4%/K, gas turbine component dominant)

a0.note: IGCC part-load floor; gasifier turndown is the limiting constraint

syngas_lhv.note: Syngas LHV after cleanup; range 10-12 MJ/Nm3 for coal syngas

flue_loss_base.note: Stack/flue gas heat loss fraction at rated load (1.5% of coal LHV input); IGCC HRSG is smaller than PC so loss is slightly lower

flue_loss_partload_coeff.note: Additional flue loss penalty per unit PLR drop below 1.0; lower combustion temperature at part load raises stack losses

aux_power_base_fraction.note: Auxiliary power fraction at rated load (ASU, pumps, compressors ~7-9%); subtracted after cycle efficiency

aux_partload_coeff.note: Auxiliary fraction increase per unit PLR drop; air separation unit cannot turn down proportionally
